event: Two extra cruisers have been sitting on Delmar since this morning.
Two extra cruisers have been sitting on Delmar since this morning.
Somebody tells Junie Marsh that Simone Adeyemi has been seen talking to police.
Fr. Emmanuel Boateng does Sgt. Hal Brennan a favour that costs them something real.
Sgt. Hal Brennan does Marisol Vasquez a favour that costs them something real.
The block loses power for six hours. Everything happens in the dark.
The 9th kicks a door on Riverside. Wrong door, as it turns out.
Something pays out for Dot Feeney. More than expected, which is its own problem.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: counts out change for Ms. Ivy Calloway
thought: He doesn't want to make eye contact, but can't help himself.

name: Junie Marsh
action: clears tables from the morning service
thought: Gus gave her the job when nobody else would - why not now?

name: Malik Reyes
action: sits alone on the block, staring at the ground
thought: Why does it feel like he's in a hole that's getting deeper?

name: Cass Deveaux
action: continues to browse Calloway's Corner
thought: She'd better not think she can outsmart me - yet.

name: Ms. Ivy Calloway
action: counts the float with the rest of the family
thought: Worth a lot to some, but I've seen it all before.

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: waits to be served at the diner
thought: I don't know how much longer I can do this without getting caught.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: nurses a drink at the diner
thought: He's not quite telling me the truth, but I'll bet he's not lying either.

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: sits at her desk at the clinic
thought: I know exactly how many hours I have left on my shift today.

name: Booker Lyle
action: signs for a delivery at his pawn shop
thought: That boy's got potential, but he's still green.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: leans on the counter at his barbershop
thought: He's been acting strange lately, and I think it's because of his sister.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: watches the door at the laundromat
thought: It's not going to get any cleaner if I don't get it out of here soon.

name: Malik Reyes
action: looks at Rosa, trying to hide his unease
thought: can't keep getting in trouble, need to stay out of trouble

name: Rey Vasquez
action: keeps working in the shop, focusing on the radio
thought: need to get the parts ready for tomorrow's job

name: Amara Bello
action: continues eating, glancing over at Malik
thought: should have just gone to the store and gotten the parts myself

name: Hector Delgado
action: leans in, listening to the conversation
thought: don't want to get involved, but need to keep an eye on things

name: Marcus Calloway
action: sits, nursing his drink, watching the conversation
thought: should probably just leave and go home

name: Rosa Reyes
action: keeps watching TV, keeping an eye on Tiny
thought: just want to make it through the evening without any more drama

name: Tiny Reyes
action: continues watching TV, completely absorbed
thought: I love my big brother, he's the best

name: Femi Adeyemi
action: keeps watching TV, trying to tune out Junie's chatter
thought: just want to get through the evening without Simone getting any worse

name: Gus Petrakis
action: continues wiping down the counter, chatting with Gus
thought: need to get the staff lined up for tomorrow's service

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: leans in, participating in the conversation
thought: need to keep the momentum going, can't let it falter now

name: Booker Lyle
action: continues reading the paper, listening to the conversation
thought: need to keep the flow going, can't let it die
